purpose: A calendar for organizing in the District: tenant meetings, know-your-rights trainings, mutual aid, teach-ins, rallies, and the culture that carries all of it.
onair_pitch: List an event here and you may hear it on 89.3 FM. Our daily Social Justice Calendar roundup reaches listeners across the DMV.

Celebrate the holiday season with us!

Music of the 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s & today provided by our very own WPFW Programmers: Jas Funk. DJ Lance Reynolds, Tony Carr, Donald Temple, and more!


Food and beverages available for purchase • Cash bar

Tickets: 

$25 General Admission
$40 Two Tickets for One
$250 Table (Sits 8 people)
$10 Students (with valid id)

Tickets will also be available for purchase at the door the day of the event - $30 each

All proceeds to benefit WPFW 89.3 FM. Come and support this LSB event and have the time of your life!

events.title: WPFW 50th Anniversary Gala
events.short_description: An evening honoring five decades of community-powered radio: music, guest speakers, special tributes, and the people who have kept 89.3 on the air since 1977. Tickets on sale in November.
events.full_description:
WPFW turns fifty on February 28, 2027, and this is the night the station marks it. An evening of music, guest speakers and special tributes at Martin's Crosswinds in Greenbelt, Maryland.

Some of the people in that room signed the station on in 1977. Some found 89.3 last week on a car radio. It is the first real chance in a long time to get listeners, volunteers, programmers and staff under one roof.

Tickets go on sale in November. The start time will be announced here and on the air.
